newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Caution prevails over optimism on Brussels bourse.
newsitem.headline: Caution prevails over optimism on Brussels bourse.

text.p: Caution was the prevailing mood on the Brussels bourse on Wednesday -- as it was on other European bourses -- after the Dow Jones sprinted higher overnight, with players waiting for a clear trend to emerge.
"We are not as bullish as the Dow, but then again we haven't had the Dow's volatility, and people are saying the Dow shouldn't lead us" one trader said.
"It wouldn't surprise me if the Bel-20 consolidated now. But if the Dow continues rising for the next few days and develops a trend then Europe will follow it," he added.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped 135.26 points or 2.1 percent to 6,587.16 -- the biggest one-day rise in its history.
At 0900 GMT the Bel-20 index .BFX was 10.35 points or 0.49 percent higher at 2,139.86, with 12 blue chips up, three unchanged and five down.
Traders said there was no particular focus, although cyclical stocks were more in favour than financials.
"That is quite normal," one trader said. "Financials are out of favour, so cyclicals are in. But with long rates moving down, financials might start to come back again."
Main gainer among Bel-20 stocks was chemicals and drugs firm UCB, up 1.1 percent at 90,850 francs.
Traders said this was largely due to a technical correction after recent relative weakness.
